_comment: The 82 seeds previously skipped on a robots.txt disallow.
Run with --ignore-robots. The User-Agent still identifies the crawler
honestly and the politeness delay is unchanged, so this bypasses the
Expect partial success. Python's robotparser reports disallow-all when
robots.txt itself returns 401/403 -- which is what a WAF does to an unknown
bot -- so some of these were never a stated preference, just bot detection,
which an honest User-Agent walks straight into.
